name: lem-stage1-left-inversion-trace
source: imports validated registry lemma proofs/lem-stage1-left-inversion-trace — Left-inversion trace over the real field: if M is a connected CW complex with dim_reals H^*(M;reals) < infinity, (M,mu,e) is an H-space, and sigma:M->M is a left inversion, then Tr(sigma^{*k}:H^k(M;reals)->H^k(M;reals))=(-1)^k*dim_reals H^k(M;reals) for every k >= 0.
